name: Lilo Slayer
source:
He is a police officer of the royal capital police. Although instructed arbitrarily by his boss Glen, he doesn't care it so much.
Even though he belongs to police, he is slack in discipline, such as feeling sympathy to suspects, giving them advice instead and leaking the internal information of the police to outside.

[Translated from [url=http://products.web-giga.com/clarias/]official website[/url]]
